subject: Discovery wrap + pilot intake: scope, metrics, owners, access
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@quanticahealth.com>; Priya Rao <priya@quanticahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery wrap + pilot intake: scope, metrics, owners, access

Hi Liam & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a common intake for the pilot: 

Primary pain points you described:
- High latency and cost spikes on batch clinical summarization jobs (esp. concurrent overnight runs)
- Occasional hallucinations on sensitive fields (diagnosis codes) causing manual review overhead
- Lack of visibility into token-level cost per pipeline stage

Pilot objectives (30-day sprint):
1) Reduce median inference latency for the summarization pipeline from ~1.1s/token to <=0.6s/token for 2k token inputs (measured at steady-state load)
2) Demonstrate >=20% token-cost reduction via batching + prefix caching vs your current endpoint
3) Validate output fidelity on 150-case prompt set (target: >=95% entity extraction precision)

Scope & success metrics (draft):
- Model: open-llm-xx (we'll propose quantization tier after access)
- Evaluation: 150-case prompt suite (we'll share the initial prompt set attached)
- Owners: Marissa (CS lead) / Ben (SE) / Avery (sales/engagement)
- Access: test S3 bucket + read-only DB view + service account for Redwood to pull dev sample data
- Timeline: kickoff week of Mar 8; first evaluation results by day 14; decision review by day 30

Immediate asks from your side to unblock kickoff:
1) Confirm target kickoff week (we suggested Mar 8)
2) Provide SSO/Okta admin contact so we can configure SCIM + SAML for the private tenant
3) Share a redacted sample of 50 records (S3 path or drive link) and indicate PII masking requirements

Attachments: pilot-charter-draft.pdf (draft charter), access-checklist.csv (fields we need pre-kickoff), initial-prompt-set.jsonl (sample prompts)

If that aligns, we can lock the kickoff date and send a short mutual action plan link for signatures.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

--
Note: attaching charter & access checklist for intake. We will iterate on metrics once we see the sample cases.
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@quanticahealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@quanticahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery wrap + pilot intake: scope, metrics, owners, access

Avery — thanks for the clear write-up. This matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Metrics: the 0.6s/token target looks achievable; can you confirm whether that is p99 or median? We care about both, but p99 is critical during batch runs.
2) Data access: we can provide an S3 path with redacted records (PII replaced with tokens) — our security team will also send the Quantica-Sec-reqs.xlsx with mandatory controls.
3) Owners: I'll be the internal sponsor and Priya will own security/ops on our side. Can Marissa be the day-to-day CS contact?

Kickoff week: Mar 8 works for us. Prefer Wed (Mar 10) morning PST.

Attaching: Quantica-Sec-reqs.xlsx (security checklist)

Thanks — I'll coordinate the SSO contact and sample data.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Platforms | Quantica Health
liam@quanticahealth.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery wrap + pilot intake: scope, metrics, owners, access

Thanks, Liam — that all works. To confirm in writing: 

- Latency metric: primary target = median <=0.6s/token; secondary target = p99 <=1.2s/token during scheduled batch windows. We'll report both in the dashboard.
- Owners: Marissa = CS day-to-day; Ben = SE/tech lead; Avery = engagement & escalation. Priya = security approver + ops contact.
- Data: please provide S3 path and SSO contact; we'll treat sample data as limited-scope for evaluation only and follow your masking requirements.
- Kickoff: tentatively Wed, Mar 10 at 10:00 AM PST. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will produce a kickoff agenda + roles matrix (by EOD Tue)
- Ben will prepare an evaluation harness and initial model config (including quantization options)
- I will publish a mutual action plan link and the signed pilot-charter-draft once we agree on kickoff date

Attachments: initial-prompt-set.jsonl (sample prompts)

A few quick asks for the kickoff meeting agenda:
- Review of success metrics and evaluation rubric (15 min)
- Data access walk-through (10 min; ops/security)
- Runbook for production safety checks and rollback (10 min)
- Timeline and decision gates (5 min)

If you can confirm Wed 10am PST, we will lock it and circulate the M.A.P.

Regards,
Avery

I'll:

- Prepare two model configs: baseline (no quant) and quantized (4-bit) so we can measure cost/latency delta
- Coordinate with Priya on SSO/service account and with Liam for the S3 path.

I'll send an invite for the technical kickoff (30 minutes) aligned to the Wed Mar 10 10:00 AM PST slot — Marissa, can you lead the customer-facing kickoff and invite the Quantica stakeholders?

Thanks — will follow up with the harness repo and quickstart notes.
